solution.summary: [Sample response] Start with the Finance operations team, where the complaints are concentrated, and deliver a trusted board pack by the end of Q2 within the approved budget. Use that early success, sponsored by the CFO, to make the case for a wider platform next year.

steps.text: Run a two-week review with Finance operations to agree the metrics behind the board pack.
Build the board pack on a single reconciled data set, aiming to finish before the end of Q2.
Keep phase one within the approved $400,000 budget by deferring the platform rebuild.
Report progress to the CFO monthly, framed around the growth target.

facts.fact: The company targets 12% annual revenue growth for three years.
facts.quote: We are targeting 12% annual revenue growth over the next three years.

facts.fact: Most reporting complaints come from Finance operations.
facts.quote: Most reporting complaints come from the Finance operations team.

facts.fact: $400,000 has been approved for analytics this year.
facts.quote: An analytics budget of $400,000 has been approved for this year.

facts.fact: The CFO sponsors the data program.
facts.quote: The CFO will act as executive sponsor for the data program.

facts.fact: The first board pack is due by the end of Q2.
facts.quote: The first board reporting pack is due by the end of Q2.

gaps: How far apart the figures in the three systems actually are.
